facts.text: We made a deal over dinner years ago. Married by twenty-eight or we marry each other. Then he brought Kimmy to the table.
facts.why: Julianne describes the pact as a night in Tucson, where Michael cuts their fingers and tells her to swear. It was not over dinner, and Michael did not bring Kimmy to a table.
facts.fix: He made me swear, years ago in Tucson. Married by twenty-eight or we marry each other. Then he found Kimmy and I lost my appetite.

facts.text: Say a little prayer. The whole table sings.
facts.why: Lunch with the wedding party ends with George singing I Say a Little Prayer and the whole restaurant joining in, not just the table.
facts.fix: George starts the song. The whole restaurant sings.

vibe.verdict: A neat invitation with the right Chicago and wedding cues, but the signed note gets the pact wrong and it skips the best gags.
